design: One-factor-at-a-time; every sweep reuses each of twelve calendars and changes only its named factor. All directions weakly preserve input feasibility: rho never exceeds 0.9, rate and lag only increase, and positive weights do not alter feasibility.

methods.FreshRatio: D01 cost-saving per one-plus aggregate freshness loss; QoDA-inspired quality/cost specialization, not QoDA reproduction
methods.LPOrder: root-LP recipient fractions followed by checked physical deletion
methods.ShareFirst: lexicographically minimize shared source cost then true cost; sharing-first specialization, not iShare or BIGSHARED reproduction
methods.DeliveryFirst: lexicographically minimize destination byte cost then true cost

literature_boundary: Tempura and Agamotto change incremental plans or execution times and are not implemented as same-domain baselines. iShare, BIGSHARED, and QoDA are credited as motivation only; named specializations are ours and use identical D01 inputs, feasibility checks, and objective accounting.
primary_metrics: relative gap to JCR using positive JCR denominator
planner time described without speed claim
